title: Time-lapse imaging of cortical projection neuron migration in mice
author: Hansen, Hippenmeyer
materials: Distance of one cell between two frames as:d(xi,xj)∑d=12(xi,d−xj,d)2

steps.title: Cool vibratome chamber
steps.instruction: Keep the vibratome cutting chamber and cutting stage at ‑20 °C before use.

steps.title: Open time‑lapse in ImageJ
steps.instruction: Launch ImageJ (FIJI) and open the desired time‑lapse file (File → Open or drag‑and‑drop the file).

steps.title: Set image calibration
steps.instruction: Go to Image → Properties and set the Frame interval to the acquisition framerate (e.g., 15 min), set Pixel width and Pixel height to the corresponding micrometer values (e.g., 1.2479 µm), and set Voxel depth to 5 µm. Save the file while keeping it open (File → Save → Replace).

steps.title: Start TrackMate
steps.instruction: Open the TrackMate plugin (ImageJ → Plugins → Tracking → TrackMate) and verify that the Calibration and Crop settings are correct for the loaded file.

steps.title: Configure LoG detector
steps.instruction: Choose the LoG detector and press Next. Select the channel to be analyzed, set Estimated blob diameter to 10.0 µm, threshold to 2.0, enable Median filter and Sub‑pixel localization, then press Next. After detection, press Next again.

steps.title: Set initial threshold
steps.instruction: Choose Auto in Initial thresholding and press Next.

steps.title: Select Hyperstack displayer
steps.instruction: In the view selection window, choose Hyperstack displayer and press Next.

steps.title: Apply spot filters (optional)
steps.instruction: In the subsequent window, apply any desired filters on spots, then press Next.

steps.title: Select Linear motion LAP tracker
steps.instruction: Choose Linear motion LAP tracker and set Initial search radius = 15, Search radius = 15, Max frame gap = 2. Press Next.

steps.title: Manually curate tracks
steps.instruction: Inspect each track; correct tracking manually or discard tracks using the TrackScheme function.

steps.title: Save TrackMate file
steps.instruction: Click “Save” to write the TrackMate project file.

steps.title: Export analysis data
steps.instruction: Click “Analysis”; three analysis windows appear. In each window, save the data as a .csv file via File → Save.

steps.title: Repeat analysis for other channel
steps.instruction: Restart the entire TrackMate process for the second image channel.

steps.title: Filter double‑labeled cells
steps.instruction: If needed, filter yellow (double‑labeled) cells by applying spot filters on Median intensity to retain only red or green labeled cells.

steps.title: Calculate migration metrics
steps.instruction: Using the exported CSV files, compute the following parameters: distance between frames d(xi,xj)=√∑d=1^2 (xi,d−xj,d)^2; total distance dtot=∑i=1^{N‑1} d(xi,xi+1); net distance dnet=d(x1,xN); net time tnet=tn−t1; straight‑line speed = dnet/tnet; directionality index = dnet/dtot. Perform statistical analysis with R, Excel, GraphPad Prism, or similar software.
